pairing: Same actual step15 checkpoint, six objects, immutable structures, catalog, weights, seed0, tools, one-action stopping and source five PNGs. Both arms use the same compact context representation.
fairness_limits: Use information necessarily changes input token length and compute. Report actual tokens/cost. Sequential fixed G-then-U order, no adaptive human changes. One development source room and one deterministic continuation per arm; no statistical superiority, learning or generalization estimate.
feedback_limits: Program outputs, not independent professional review. Access uses frozen body/door/grid/approach assumptions. Inventory is researcher operational coverage, not exact asset requirements or functionality truth. No target placement coordinates/reference furniture layout/after-the-fact professional rationale.
acceptance: Both final states undergo identical read-only audit of actual geometry, immutable objects, inventory, conditional access, side effects and unknowns. Missing functions/deletions/empty area do not count as success. Preserve failed calls and partial outputs.

placement_noise.rule: Upstream perfect placement uses deterministic input-transform-derived seed. Same command/input gives same noise under fixed implementation; no extra stochastic seed changed.

authorization: Existing Goal and authorized local frozen policy/GPU/assets; no optimizer, paid API or external contact.
restoration_policy: Use existing native checkpoint allowance only: all non-quaternion fields exactly equal, quaternion components differ at most1e-12. Log source/current hashes and every difference. On rollout restoration refresh first request from actual current state; all arguments/receipts unchanged. Both arms share original five PNG bytes with numerical-equivalence disclosure.
